human_recipe.target_compound: Au-Sn plasmonic alloy nanoparticles (AuxSn1-x, x = 8-41 mol% Sn)

steps.description: Add 58.56 mL water and 1.2 mL of 10 mM HAuCl4 to 100 mL round-bottom flask in oil bath at 125°C, stirred at 640 rpm, and bring to reflux.

At reflux, add 480 μL of 100 mM sodium citrate solution. Solution turns purple then reddish pink within 3-5 min. Heat for 8 min, then cool to room temperature. Use seeds at ~0.7 O.D. (Au seed synthesis).
Add 40-200 μL of 5 mM SnCl4·5H2O to 3 mL Au seeds under vigorous stirring at room temperature. Add water to bring total volume to 4 mL. Add ~0.025 mg PVP-40000.
Transfer reaction vials to water bath at 60°C for 10 min.
Remove vials and add 120-200 μL of 260 mM NaBH4 under stirring. Return to water bath at 60°C for 20 min. PVP:metal and NaBH4:metal ratios fixed at 0.05:1 and 30:1 respectively.
Centrifuge 8 min at 8500 rpm. Remove supernatant and resuspend in water.

human_recipe.notes: Sn composition controlled by varying volume of 5 mM SnCl4·5H2O (40-200 μL). 60°C gives most blue-shifted LSPR and highest Au5Sn phase fraction; lower temps give more AuSn, 80°C gives minimal shift. Mixed phase system: substitutional AuxSn1-x alloy coexists with Au5Sn and AuSn intermetallics. All water 18.2 MΩ resistivity.

human_recipe.target_compound: Au-PTM plasmonic alloy nanoparticles (AuxBi1-x ~6%, AuxGa1-x trace, AuxIn1-x ~10%)

steps.description: Synthesize Au seeds via citrate reduction identical to Au-Sn procedure (HAuCl4 + sodium citrate, reflux 125°C, 640 rpm, 8 min).
Add PTM precursor solution (10 mol% equivalent) and PVP to Au seeds. For Ga and Bi: incubate in ice bath 10 min. For In: incubate at 60°C for 10 min.
Add NaBH4. For Ga and Bi: incubate in ice bath 10 additional min. For In: allow to stand at room temperature 10 min.

human_recipe.notes: Conditions modified from Au-Sn: Ga/Bi use ice bath (not 60°C) for both incubation steps; In uses 60°C then room temperature. Incorporated compositions (ICP-MS): Bi ~6.1%, Ga trace only (colloidal instability), In ~9.9%. Nanoparticles stable ≥1 h. XRD shows Au-like fcc pattern, no intermetallic phases at 10 mol% PTM loading.

human_recipe.target_compound: Ag-Sn plasmonic alloy nanoparticles (AgxSn1-x, 9-23 mol% Sn incorporated)

steps.description: Mix 1 mL sodium citrate (35 mM), 250 μL AgNO3 (59 mM), 50 μL NaBr (80 mM) in 1.25 mL water, stir at room temperature 5 min.

Add 500 μL ascorbic acid (100 mM) to 47.4 mL boiling water in 100 mL flask (oil bath 125°C, 600 rpm). After 1 min, add citrate/AgNO3/NaBr solution. Hold at reflux 1 h with stirring. Solution turns colorless to yellow.

Centrifuge at 4100 rpm for 15 min to remove larger nanoparticles; save supernatant. Centrifuge supernatant at 11400 rpm for 30 min; resuspend in 2 mM aqueous sodium citrate. Use seeds at O.D. ~3. (Ag seed purification)
Add 1.30 mL Ag seeds to 6.02 mL water. Add 100 μL AgNO3 (10 mM) under stirring. Add 160-460 μL SnCl4·5H2O (5 mM) depending on target composition. Add 190-300 μL sodium citrate (30 mM).
Transfer to water bath at 60°C for 10 min.
Add 150-215 μL NaBH4 (120 mM). Return to water bath at 60°C for 20 min.

human_recipe.notes: Seeded co-reduction method. Sn composition controlled by volume of SnCl4 solution (160-460 μL for 40-66 mol% Sn added; incorporated 9-23 mol% by ICP-MS). LSPR shifts from ~400 nm (Ag seeds) to 365 nm at 23% Sn. Mixed phase: substitutional Ag-Sn alloy + Ag3Sn intermetallic at higher Sn. NaBr used as shape-directing agent in seed synthesis. All water 18.2 MΩ resistivity.
